reviewer: independent he4_source_audit agent; not external-interface implementer
review_method: Independent source/code and raw-output review, source-byte verification, dimensional and event-owner derivation. No duplicate numerical suite and no new physical solver.

preexecution_findings_fixed.finding: Direct ProperSource/IntegratedSource constructors could bypass normalization, finite-sign or paired-array checks.
preexecution_findings_fixed.resolution: Immutable paired tuples, typed native/scaling parents, finite nonnegative values, exact rate=factor*weight and count=exposure*rate relations enforced in __post_init__.

preexecution_findings_fixed.finding: Domain support and epoch metadata needed finite ordered input validation.
preexecution_findings_fixed.resolution: Constructor requires nondegenerate finite nonnegative support, explicit finite epoch tuple and frame/angular/mass values; request path rejects boolean redshifts and scope extension.

preexecution_findings_fixed.finding: Provider source/evaluated beta evidence could be arbitrary truthy strings.
preexecution_findings_fixed.resolution: SourcePin instances for source, prior admission review and all nine beta evidence fields; actual bytes/digests checked. Function is explicitly identity/compatibility validation, not scientific admission.

dimensional_acceptance: Native weights are masses of finite atomic energy measures. No extra bin-width or phase-space Jacobian is applied.
Per-target/proper-time source multiplies target density once. Already volumetric source uses factor one and rejects extra density fields.
Coordinate/comoving source divides by both proper-volume and proper-time Jacobians. Per-reference source multiplies proper reference density and divides clock Jacobian.
Population moments and injection rate have distinct normalization; source history remains absent unless explicitly supplied.
Constant exposure integration is a separate type with exact one-time exposure relation.
physical_owner_acceptance: C23B PI assigns photon -(I+K), binding +I, fast +K, thermal 0 with the same event extent and conditional isotope mapping.
C23E saved signed PI/RR/CX rates retain original density ownership. Adapter applies cm^-3 to m^-3 and eV to J only, including sign-correct net CX.
Nuclear composition and charge close at each event; exact reservoir set prevents duplicate reservoir labels; common frame is explicit.
Case-A C23E escaped photons stay separate from retained-photon H1/HeI RR contracts.
Thermal temperature derivative subtracts species-count derivatives from Udot before dividing by Cv. Molecular/level EOS remains separate.
Caloric split returns physical heating and thermal transfer null and irreversible assimilation false; signed cutoff flux gives paired count/energy exchange only.
strongest_retained_boundaries: EventBook deduplicates canonical event IDs within one ledger. It cannot infer that differently named events are aliases of the same physical absorption; current adapters assign deterministic canonical IDs and ownership reconciliation remains caller responsibility.

SourcePin validates bytes and declared immutable identity. Scientific validity and binding of provider scope to the independent review remain responsibilities of the source/admission reviewer, not a self-asserted status string.
Massive-particle total-energy moments include rest energy as diagnostics. They must not be added again to the present binding/kinetic ledger or interpreted as heating.
Scalar isotropic-ensemble closure is not event-level momentum conservation or a finite-recoil/angular emission law.
External beta, spectral history, baryon distribution and HE cascade/stopping physical payloads remain pending. Passing algebraic interface controls does not admit those physical providers.
Exact redshift nodes, 50keV source bound, conditional H1/He4 and D43 shared-H isotope assumptions remain unchanged.
